lines.en: One stride carries me a stretch of ground.

lines.zh: 身体是紫黑色的，边缘有光。
lines.en: My body is purple-black, rimmed with light.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，空气在响。
lines.en: The air hums where I pass.
I raise a long arm, then lower it.
I don't touch ground; I drift.
I cross a stretch of end stone.
Particles trail behind me.
I turn, and the glow turns with me.
I stop on a raised platform.
End stone doesn't ring when I move.
I hover there, unmoving.
Purple light bleeds off me.
I raise my head, but there's no face.
The air vibrates around me.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，看它发光。
lines.en: I raise a hand and watch it glow.
Purple light bleeds off me. I'm very quiet.
It's an uncomfortable quiet.

lines.zh: 这片安静叫人发毛，而我不喘气。
lines.en: The quiet is unsettling, and I don't breathe.
Perhaps I shouldn't exist.
Yet here I am.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到每一块石头的温度。
lines.en: I can feel the temperature of every stone.
Purple flows across me.

lines.zh: 我把手抬到眼前，又移开。
lines.en: I raise a hand before my eyes, then move it away.
There's a faint light far off.

lines.zh: 那是个什么东西，我说不准。
lines.en: What that is, I can’t say.
I decide to go look.
I turn to you, light falling.

lines.zh: 那道光洒下，你腰背挺得笔直。
lines.en: The light falls, and your back is straight.

lines.zh: 你举着家伙对着我，我懒得避。
lines.en: You aim that at me. I don't bother dodging.
I raise my hand, slowly.

lines.zh: 我把手一抬，你便退后半步。
lines.en: I lift a hand and you take half a step back.

lines.zh: 你退了这小半步，正合我意。
lines.en: That half-step back is exactly right.
I watch you without feeling.
I'm only waiting for you to move.

lines.zh: 你一看我的眼睛，就晚了。
lines.en: Once you meet my eyes, it's too late.
Shadows can't block light.
The purple light scatters.
My glowing rim dims a little.

lines.zh: 我的边缘被打散了，又聚回去。
lines.en: My edge was scattered. It gathers back.

lines.zh: 空气的嗡鸣断了，我一声不出。
lines.en: The hum stops. I make no sound.
The air's hum stops.

lines.zh: 那一击碰上实体，我倒退半格。
lines.en: That found something solid. I recede half a block.

lines.zh: 我稳住身形，光却暗了几分。
lines.en: I steady myself, and my light dims.
It dims, then brightens again.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，这对我没用。
lines.en: You hold up food. That does nothing for me.
I have no stomach. I can't eat.

lines.zh: 你举着方块，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: You hold up a block. I'm not interested.
Holding it up won't make me eat.

lines.zh: 还要的是别的东西，你收起来吧。
lines.en: I want something else. Put it away.

lines.zh: 我想取走的，是另一样东西。
lines.en: What I want to take is something else.
Your attention, for instance.

lines.zh: 我想要的是你走神，你果然走神了。
lines.en: I wanted your attention to slip. It slipped.

lines.zh: 我等的那一瞬来了，动手。
lines.en: The moment I waited for. Now.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，穿过去一半。
lines.en: You hit me and half pass through.

lines.zh: 你穿过去一半，你摔在地上。
lines.en: You pass halfway through and land hard.

lines.zh: 我不用挪地方，这身子本是虚的。
lines.en: I needn't move. This body is barely solid.
My body isn't quite solid.
What you touched was cold.
I gather myself again.

lines.zh: 你摸到的地方冰得吓人，退开了。
lines.en: What you touched was ice-cold. You pulled away.
Some things shouldn't be touched.

lines.zh: 有些东西碰不得，我照旧悬着。
lines.en: Some things shouldn't be touched. I keep hovering.
I hover where I was.
Endermen have kin too.

lines.zh: 那些黑影尚有同族，我一个也没有。
lines.en: Those shadows have kin. I have none.
I was assembled.

lines.zh: 手举了半天，半个人影也没召来。
lines.en: Hand raised, and nothing came.

lines.zh: 紫色的辉光从我身上渗出来。
lines.en: Violet radiance seeps from me.

lines.zh: 紫光从身上漫出去，够我用了。
lines.en: Purple light seeps from me. That's enough.
I hover where I am, waiting.

lines.zh: 不必有谁应我，这世界已经很静。
lines.en: I need no answer. The world is quiet enough.

lines.zh: 有没有人应我，我不在乎。
lines.en: Whether anyone answers doesn't matter.
The world is quiet. Keep hovering.
I raise a hand and it floats.
Purple light wraps it.

lines.zh: 紫光裹住了它，我没有伸手。
lines.en: Purple light wraps it. I don't reach out.
It turns once before my palm.

lines.zh: 它在我掌前打了个转，坠了下去。
lines.en: It turns once at my palm, then falls.
Once it's turned, I don't need it.

lines.zh: 我顺手把它拨到了旁边。
lines.en: I nudge it out of the way.

lines.zh: 我把它拨开，你愿意就捡走。
lines.en: I push it aside. Pick it up if you like.
After pushing it, I don't care.

lines.zh: 我抬手，让光重新拢住我。
lines.en: I raise a hand and let the light close over me.
The air shivers hard. You moved.
I turn to you and the purple light brightens.

lines.zh: 紫光一盛，我这边就对着你。
lines.en: The purple flares, and I'm squared to you.
This time I won't be slow.
That wall won't stop my light.
The air begins to thrum.
Your ears will ache.
Out of everything here, I've chosen you.
Open your eyes and look at me.
I want you watching.
Just like that. Move no more.
Then it begins.
I raise both hands.
Light pours from my palms.

lines.zh: 我把四周的光都收过来。
lines.en: I draw in all the light around.
That's all because of me.
You hear the air keening.
You're still running.
But I'm already ahead.
I don't walk the ground.
You look back, and there I am.
The purple light follows you.
It doesn't tire.

lines.zh: 那道光不疲倦，我比它更能熬。
lines.en: The light never tires. I outlast it.
Your steps are breaking up.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，从砖缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Your breathing leaks through the bricks.
Your heartbeat echoes off the walls.
It's getting faster.
I raise my hand and light gathers.
You raise your shield.
A shield won't stop light.
Now you know.
Then stop trying.
I'll take my time.
You have a few seconds.
Make them count.
I enclose you in light.
One palm down, and the purple bursts.
You're thrown into the wall.

lines.zh: 你被气浪拍到墙上，我并未沾手。
lines.en: The blast throws you to the wall. I never touched you.
I didn't touch you. The light did.
The other hand comes up too.

lines.zh: 第二只手抬起，你又缩了回去。
lines.en: The second hand rises and you flinch back.
This time you don't get clear.

lines.zh: 这回你没躲开，滚倒在地。
lines.en: This time you don't clear it. You roll.

lines.zh: 我停在你头顶，慢条斯理。
lines.en: I hang above you, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比末地石还硬。
lines.en: My fist is harder than end stone.

lines.zh: 你还撑得住，那就再站起来。
lines.en: You can still rise. Then rise.
I'll wait for you. Come.
I gather out of the air.
First an outline, then the light.

lines.zh: 末地的石板在我脚下裂开。
lines.en: End stone cracks beneath me.

lines.zh: 末地的石板裂开，我没有脚。
lines.en: End stone cracks. I have no feet.
I hover and turn once, slowly.
This isn't the End.

lines.zh: 这儿不是末地，空得却差不多。
lines.en: Not the End, but just as empty.
I turn once. I raise a hand.
Light falls from my fingers.
It burns a ring into the ground.

lines.zh: 附近有活的，我察觉得到。
lines.en: Something living is near. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我戴着末影人的脸，别对视。
lines.en: I wear an enderman's face; don't meet my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从末地的裂缝里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of an End rift.

lines.zh: 它尚且没察觉，我候它抬眼。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed. I wait for it to look up.

lines.zh: 我等它抬头，等它看见我。
lines.en: I wait for it to look up, until it sees me.
Then it's simple.
For the last time. Begin.

lines.zh: 末地石在我脚下响了一声。
lines.en: The end stone rang once under my feet.
It finally looks up.

lines.zh: 火穿过我，只留下一点热。
lines.en: Fire passes through me, leaving only warmth.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，一路散成粒子。
lines.en: I fall, scattering into particles.

lines.zh: 水穿不过我，却让我发闷。
lines.en: Water doesn't pass through; it smothers me.

lines.zh: 弹丸钻进我的身体就不见了。
lines.en: A round enters my body and vanishes.

lines.zh: 两股力量撞在一起，我退了。
lines.en: Two powers collide and I recoil.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我也会空。
lines.en: I don't eat, but I can still run empty.

lines.zh: 雷电和我的光撞在一起。
lines.en: Lightning meets my light.
The void simply takes me back.
